question: Which special representation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies was discontinued by the 104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anglo-Indian Reservation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The **104th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2020**, abolished the provision for the nomination of **two Anglo-Indian members** in the Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies of states.
 
• Prior to this amendment, Article **331** of the Constitution of India provided for the reservation of two seats in the Lok Sabha for the Anglo-Indian community, which was a nominated category.
